narr: Within a moist airmass, a lingering surface frontal boundary led to the development of scattered showers and thunderstorms. Over the Coastal Plain, a storm cell produced localized flash flooding near the town of Smithfield.
ev: A water rescue was reported at 2nd Street and Holding St. Additionally, a flooded car was reported at Brogden Rd and S Brightleaf Blvd.
lsr: Water rescue at 2nd St and Holding St. Flooded car at Brogden Rd near Food Lion. Water in houses along Holt St and S Fifth St.
